item.title: NEVADA VIEWS: Planning for a resilient economic future
item.description: Southern Nevada has a proud history of competing — and winning — through boldness and reinvention. We have developed a world-class tourism economy, built globally recognized brands and demonstrated our ability to rebound from significant disruptions. In today’s fiercely competitive global economy, however, we must intentionally design the next chapter of our economic story. Communities worldwide are continuously enhancing their sophistication, and we must keep pace.

item.title: Iran fires missiles at Israel and Gulf states after US-Israeli strike kills supreme leader
